name: @house/mcp
description: MCP server that lets an AI agent design a 3D house (rooms, furniture, lights, finishes) through validated edit operations.

scripts.build: esbuild src/server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=dist/server.mjs --banner:js="#!/usr/bin/env node" --legal-comments=none && mkdir -p ../../plugins/house-design/server && cp dist/server.mjs ../../plugins/house-design/server/house-mcp.mjs
